expr: const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-file-card]')].find(c => c.querySelector('.filecard__name').textContent.includes('色块')); const chip = [...card.querySelectorAll('.chip')].find(c => c.textContent.includes('JPEG')); if (!chip) return { error: 'no jpeg chip', chips: [...card.querySelectorAll('.chip')].map(c=>c.textContent.trim()) }; chip.click(); return { clicked: 'jpeg' };

const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-file-card]')].find(c => c.querySelector('.filecard__name').textContent.includes('音调')); const chip = [...card.querySelectorAll('.chip')].find(c => c.textContent.includes('MP3')); if (!chip) return { error: 'no mp3 chip', chips: [...card.querySelectorAll('.chip')].map(c=>c.textContent.trim()) }; chip.click(); return { clicked: 'mp3' };

return { done: document.querySelectorAll('[data-state=done]').length, error: document.querySelectorAll('[data-state=error]').length, results: [...document.querySelectorAll('.result')].map(r => ({ name: r.querySelector('.result__name')?.textContent, badges: [...r.querySelectorAll('.badge')].map(b => b.textContent.trim()) })), errors: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-status=fail] .case__detail')].map(e => e.textContent.slice(0, 200)), notes: [...document.querySelectorAll('.case__detail')].map(e => e.textContent.slice(0, 140)).slice(0, 10), wasm: typeof WebAssembly !== 'undefined', offscreen: typeof OffscreenCanvas !== 'undefined' };
